environment.notes: Local virtual lab only; no Bluetooth adapter. Same-host private IPv4 peer; no true OS-cache-cold measurement.
environment.display: Xvfb 2560x1800x24, default system/application scale; exact values in startup.jvm

method.startup: native packaged launcher to painted visible GUI plus EDT round trip; 20 ms polling
method.first_launch: fresh disposable profile, OS page cache uncontrolled; NOT true cold boot
method.warm_launch: same profile, fresh JVM; OS cache may be warm
method.resources: RSS sum and user+system CPU for target process tree; one CPU core = 100%; peer excluded
method.lan: same-host private IPv4 TCP, signed protocol, persisted trust/receipts and actual GUI; lab helper overhead included
method.workload: 256 UTF-8 bytes, up to 5 messages/s per direction, new empty history
method.bluetooth: unavailable in automated TCP lab; use sample on a real adapter

jvm.os.name: Linux
jvm.readiness: visible root pane painted, toolkit synchronized, EDT round trip completed
